cases.name: Elizabeth M. "Lizzie" Garrow
cases.about: Her obituary said "She enjoyed cooking, taking pictures, and crocheting, and loved being a mother, as well as spending time with her family and friends."
cases.narrative: On 9/27/2020, her body was found dumped near an overpass which carries Main Street in Canastota over the New York State Thruway.
